primary.title: Foreign salary in NRE account not taxable for NRIs, ITAT quashes ₹12 lakh tax demand
primary.summary: The ITAT Ahmedabad has ruled that foreign salary earned outside India does not become taxable merely because it is credited to an NRE account or because TDS is deducted using an Indian TAN.
